desc: Fresh profile: built-in server started and owner created
QR decoder available for independent decoding
Business Profile name saved in Food Court Settings and stored by the server
UPI ID validation: bad format and "enabled without a UPI ID" show clear messages and block Save
evidence: Enter a valid UPI ID such as name@bank (letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, then @ and the provider handle). | Enter the merchant UPI ID before turning on UPI QR payments.

desc: Owner saves the UPI ID and enables UPI QR: success message shown, server stores it
Cashier cannot change the UPI ID (403) but can read it for the QR
A Rs 200 takeaway order is created by the cashier
Receipt preview: business name from the profile is the top line; address/phone shown; no GSTIN line (not configured)
Receipt preview shows "SCAN & PAY USING UPI", the UPI ID, Rs 200.00 and the order reference
evidence: -20261104-MBRWK Scan with any UPI app and pay exactly ₹200.00. Show the payment confirmation at the counter. *** UNPAID - NOT A RECEIPT *** Thank you! Visit again. Powered by MangalMurti Tech Solution

desc: QR payload: pa=configured UPI ID, am=200.00, cu=INR, pn=business name, tn=order reference
An independent decoder (jsQR) reads the QR rendered in the preview and gets exactly that payload
Preview at 58 mm: QR is square, inside the paper, and still decodes to the same payload
POS UPI panel: QR for this bill with Rs 200.00, configured UPI ID and the same reference as the bill preview
jsQR decodes the POS QR to the exact payload
Payment stays PENDING: Confirm is disabled without a bank reference or without the "I verified it" tick; order still unpaid
After reference + verification the bill is paid by UPI with the bank reference stored, and the confirmation is audited
Print 80 mm: business name first line, PAID VIA UPI record with the ORIGINAL payload, one print request
Print 80 mm: receipt is 72 mm wide (80 mm roll less margins) on one page; QR square, inside it, nothing overflows
evidence: pdf-sheet=215.9mm (sheet size is the printer driver's) pages=1 qr=162.0px root=272.1px (72.0mm)

desc: Print 80 mm: jsQR decodes the QR in the print output
Print 58 mm: receipt is 48 mm wide (58 mm roll less margins) on one page; QR square and inside it
QR module size is >= 0.5 mm on both rolls and jsQR decodes the 58 mm print to the same payload
Payment History reprint: same order, same QR payload and reference as the original
After the owner changes the UPI ID, reprinting the old receipt still shows the ORIGINAL UPI ID, amount and reference
New unpaid bill (after the UPI ID change): QR routes to the NEW UPI ID, Rs 200.00, a different reference
jsQR decodes the unpaid bill QR from the print output
Another bill's reference, a wrong amount, a re-used bank reference and a missing verification are all refused; the order stays unpaid
A cancelled order cannot be paid through its stale QR
UPI disabled: the bill preview has no QR section and still shows the business name
UPI disabled: the server refuses to create a QR with a clear message
evidence: UPI QR payments are turned off. The owner can enable them in Food Court Settings.

desc: UPI disabled: POS shows a clear "not set up" message and no payment QR
evidence: UPI QR is not set up, so no payment QR can be shown. Ask the owner to add the UP

desc: Cash payment through the POS still settles a bill unchanged
No unexpected renderer errors during the whole run
